pairs.target: " shǒu shōuhuí lái , bié tàn . "
pairs.english: “Withdraw your hand; don't reach in.”
pairs.hanzi: “手收回来，别探。”

pairs.target: shào píng pèng le pèng lín zhào de gēbo .
pairs.english: Shao Ping touched Lin Zhao on the arm.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平碰了碰林照的胳膊。

pairs.target: tā suōhuí shǒu , cái fājué qiánmiàn wǔgè rén dōu zài děng .
pairs.english: She withdrew her hand and only then realized that all five people in front were waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 她缩回手，才发觉前面五个人都在等。

pairs.target: xǔ cén jiāng mùxiá shōu jìn tiēshēn de pítào , zhǐzhe shéng hòu de shíjiē shuō : " shàngqù xiān bié sàn .
pairs.english: Xu Cen put the case into a leather sleeve worn against her body and pointed at the steps beyond the rope, saying, “Once we're up there, don't split up yet.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑将木匣收进贴身的皮套，指着绳后的石阶说：“上去先别散。

pairs.target: yào tuì jiù yán yuán lù huí zhèlǐ , tīngjiàn biéchù yǒurén hǎn , yě bié gēnzhe zǒu . "
pairs.english: If we retreat, then come back here along the way we came; even if you hear someone calling elsewhere, don't follow.”
pairs.hanzi: 要退就沿原路回这里，听见别处有人喊，也别跟着走。”

pairs.target: lín zhào diǎntóu , shēnshǒu fúzhù bèi jià .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao nodded and reached out to steady her frame.
pairs.hanzi: 林照点头，伸手扶住背架。

pairs.target: dùhéng xiān kuà le guòqù , bànbiān dùn shàng lìkè méng le yìcéng shuǐ guāng .
pairs.english: Du Heng stepped through first; at once, half his shield was covered in a sheen of water.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡先跨了过去，半边盾上立刻蒙了一层水光。

pairs.target: suíhòu shì shěn yàn zhōu hé qī lán .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou and Qi Lan came next.
pairs.hanzi: 随后是沈砚舟和戚岚。

pairs.target: xǔ cén zài jiēxià cèshēn ràngkāi , děng liǎnggè bānyùn de gēnshàng , wēn shù cái zǒu dào zuìhòu .
pairs.english: Xu Cen turned sideways at the foot of the steps to make room; once both porters had followed, Wen Shu then took up the rear.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑在阶下侧身让开，等两个搬运的跟上，温述才走到最后。

pairs.target: lún dào lín zhào shí , tā dīzhetóu , tèyì kàn le yìyǎn xié jiān .
pairs.english: When the turn came to Lin Zhao, she lowered her head and deliberately looked at the toe of her shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到林照时，她低着头，特意看了一眼鞋尖。

pairs.target: xiédǐ hái cǎi zhe gān shíxiè , éqián yǐjīng luòxià yǔlái .
pairs.english: Her soles still rested on dry stone chips, yet rain had already begun falling on her forehead.
pairs.hanzi: 鞋底还踩着干石屑，额前已经落下雨来。

pairs.target: tā měngdì bìyǎn , yìgǔ liángqì shùnzhe lǐngkǒu zuānjìn bèixīn .
pairs.english: She shut her eyes with a start as a rush of cold air slipped down her back through her collar.
pairs.hanzi: 她猛地闭眼，一股凉气顺着领口钻进背心。

pairs.target: zài zhēng kāishí , jiǎoxià quán shì shī de , fāngcái nà liǎnggēn mùzhù què bújiàn le .
pairs.english: When she opened her eyes again, everything underfoot was wet, but those two wooden posts from a moment ago had vanished.
pairs.hanzi: 再睁开时，脚下全是湿的，方才那两根木柱却不见了。

pairs.target: tā huítóu , zhī kànjiàn yípiàn liàng dé huǎngyǎn de quēkǒu , shào píngzhèng cóng liàng chù màichū lái , kùjiǎo háishì gān de , xià yíshùn biàn yě shēn le yì jié .
pairs.english: She turned and saw only a dazzlingly bright opening; Shao Ping was stepping from the light, his trouser hems still dry, then in the next instant a section of them darkened too.
pairs.hanzi: 她回头，只看见一片亮得晃眼的缺口，邵平正从亮处迈出来，裤脚还是干的，下一瞬便也深了一截。

pairs.target: " zǒu a . "
pairs.english: “Come on,”
pairs.hanzi: “走啊。”

pairs.target: tā shuō .
pairs.english: he said.
pairs.hanzi: 他说。

pairs.target: lín zhào mǒ le bǎ liǎn , zhuī shàng tā de jiǎobù .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao wiped her face and matched his pace.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抹了把脸，追上他的脚步。

pairs.target: shíjiē shàngtóu shì yípiàn kuānkuò de táidì , suì zhù héng zài jīshuǐ lǐ , zuì yuǎnchù háiyǒu bàndǔ gāoqiáng , qiángshàng cháng zhe tā méi jiàn guò de bái yè téng .
pairs.english: Above the steps lay a broad terrace; broken columns stretched across standing water, and at the farthest end stood half a high wall, with white-leaved vines she had never seen growing over it.
pairs.hanzi: 石阶上头是一片宽阔的台地，碎柱横在积水里，最远处还有半堵高墙，墙上长着她没见过的白叶藤。

pairs.target: yǔ cóng tóudǐng de huī guāng lǐ luòxià , wàng bújiàn shān , yě wàng bújiàn chéngwài nàtiáo hédī .
pairs.english: Rain fell from the gray light overhead; she could see no mountains, nor could she see the river embankment outside the city.
pairs.hanzi: 雨从头顶的灰光里落下，望不见山，也望不见城外那条河堤。

pairs.target: tā zǒu dào yìgēn zhù páng , cái kànqīng shàngtóu kè zhe sānháng zì .
pairs.english: She walked to a column; only then could she make out three lines of characters carved on it.
pairs.hanzi: 她走到一根柱旁，才看清上头刻着三行字。

pairs.target: nàxiē zì yòu xì yòu cháng , yǒu de tuō chū yídào wān gōu , xiàng mòshōu hǎo de shéng tóu , kě shùnzhe kàn xiàqù , jìng zhǎobùchū yígè rènde de .
pairs.english: The characters were both slender and long, some trailing a curved hook like an untidied rope end, yet as she followed them she could not find a single one she recognized.
pairs.hanzi: 那些字又细又长，有的拖出一道弯钩，像没收好的绳头，可顺着看下去，竟找不出一个认得的。

pairs.target: " jiān cè guòlái . "
pairs.english: “Angle your shoulder,”
pairs.hanzi: “肩侧过来。”

pairs.target: shào píng shuō .
pairs.english: Shao Ping said.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平说。

pairs.target: tā máng shōu le mùguāng .
pairs.english: She hurriedly looked away.
pairs.hanzi: 她忙收了目光。

pairs.target: bèi jià biānyán cā zhe zhùzi guòqù , méi pèngshàng .
pairs.english: The edge of the frame passed close beside the column without touching it.
pairs.hanzi: 背架边沿擦着柱子过去，没碰上。

pairs.target: táidì jìntóu yǒu zuò duàn le dǐng de mén , mén hòu liǎngtiáolù , yìtiáo wǎngyòu xià , shíjiē shàng zhèng tǎng zhe shuǐ ; lìng yìtiáo yán zuǒcè zhùláng ràoguòqù , zhōng jiàngé zhe yípiàn xiàn xiàqù de dìmiàn .
pairs.english: At the terrace's end stood a gateway with its roof broken off; beyond it were two paths, one descending right with water streaming down the steps, the other circling along the colonnade on the left, a stretch of sunken ground dividing them.
pairs.hanzi: 台地尽头有座断了顶的门，门后两条路，一条往右下，石阶上正淌着水；另一条沿左侧柱廊绕过去，中间隔着一片陷下去的地面。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu tíng zài ménnèi , qǔchū fāng jǐn gěi de zhǐ , yā zài hái gān zhe de shí miànshàng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou stopped inside the gateway, took out the sheet Fang Jin had given him, and held it down on a stone surface that was still dry.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟停在门内，取出方谨给的纸，压在还干着的石面上。

pairs.target: wēn shù bèizhe fēng cā le liǎngxià huǒshí , diǎn qǐ yìzhǎn yóudēng .
pairs.english: Sheltering from the wind, Wen Shu struck the flint twice and lit an oil lamp.
pairs.hanzi: 温述背着风擦了两下火石，点起一盏油灯。

pairs.target: " zuówǎn zǒu de shì yòubiān ? "
pairs.english: “You took the right-hand route last night?”
pairs.hanzi: “昨晚走的是右边？”

pairs.target: xǔ cén fǔshēn kàn tú .
pairs.english: Xu Cen bent to look at the map.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑俯身看图。

pairs.target: " shuǐ bǐ tànlù shí dà le .
pairs.english: “There's more water than when it was scouted.
pairs.hanzi: “水比探路时大了。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān wǒ zài tīng yi tīng . "
pairs.english: I will listen along the left again.”
pairs.hanzi: 左边我再听一听。”

pairs.target: tā xiàng qī lán shēnchūshǒu , jiē lái yìzhī jiàn , yòng zhǐ fù yán jiàntóu mǒ le yídào .
pairs.english: She held out her hand to Qi Lan, took an arrow, and ran the pad of her finger along its head.
pairs.hanzi: 她向戚岚伸出手，接来一支箭，用指腹沿箭头抹了一道。

pairs.target: tiě shàngfú qǐ yìdiǎn dàn bái .
pairs.english: A faint whiteness surfaced on the iron.
pairs.hanzi: 铁上浮起一点淡白。

pairs.target: lín zhào hái yǐwéi shì yǔ guāng , shāoshāo piān guò liǎn , nà diǎn bái què liúzài yuánchù , xì dé xiàng qiàn zài tiě lǐ de yìgēn xiàn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao thought it was only the gleam of rain and tilted her face a little, but that white trace stayed in place, fine as a thread set into the iron.
pairs.hanzi: 林照还以为是雨光，稍稍偏过脸，那点白却留在原处，细得像嵌在铁里的一根线。

pairs.target: tā rěnbúzhù qù kàn xǔ cén de shǒuzhǐ , zhǐ fù gāngānjìngjìng , shénme yě méiyǒu zhān .
pairs.english: She could not help looking at Xu Cen's fingers; the pads were perfectly clean, with nothing clinging to them.
pairs.hanzi: 她忍不住去看许岑的手指，指腹干干净净，什么也没有沾。

pairs.target: " zuǒbiān dìèrgēn héngliáng , xià yán . "
pairs.english: “The lower edge of the second crossbeam on the left.”
pairs.hanzi: “左边第二根横梁，下沿。”

pairs.target: qī lán dā jiàn .
pairs.english: Qi Lan nocked the arrow.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚搭箭。

pairs.target: xián xiǎng guòhòu , jiàn yuèguò tāxiàn de shí dì , dīngjìn zhùláng shēnchù de mùtou , wěiyǔ wēiwēi yí chàn .
pairs.english: After the bowstring twanged, the arrow flew over the collapsed paving and buried itself in the wood deep in the colonnade, its fletching trembling faintly.
pairs.hanzi: 弦响过后，箭越过塌陷的石地，钉进柱廊深处的木头，尾羽微微一颤。

pairs.target: xǔ cén méiyǒu zhuī zhe kàn , fǎnér bì shàng le yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: Xu Cen did not keep watching; instead, she closed her eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑没有追着看，反而闭上了眼睛。

pairs.target: zhòngrén dōu jìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: Everyone fell quiet.
pairs.hanzi: 众人都静下来。

pairs.target: lín zhào tīngjiàn yǔ qiāo zài mén dǐng cányú de shíbǎn shàng , shuǐzhū cóng yídào lièkǒu dī jìn āocáo , kōngkòng dì xiǎng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao heard rain drumming on the remaining slabs atop the gateway, water drops dripping through a crack into a groove with a hollow sound.
pairs.hanzi: 林照听见雨敲在门顶残余的石板上，水珠从一道裂口滴进凹槽，空空地响。

pairs.target: chúle zhèxiē , tā tīngbújiàn biéde .
pairs.english: Apart from that, she could hear nothing else.
pairs.hanzi: 除了这些，她听不见别的。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , xǔ cén táiqǐ shǒu , shìyì tāmen biédòng .
pairs.english: After a while, Xu Cen raised her hand, signaling them not to move.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，许岑抬起手，示意他们别动。

pairs.target: " yǒu dōngxī cā zhe liáng zǒu .
pairs.english: “Something is moving along the beam, scraping against it.
pairs.hanzi: “有东西擦着梁走。

pairs.target: tíng le . "
pairs.english: It's stopped.”
pairs.hanzi: 停了。”

pairs.target: dùhéng bǎ diàosuǒ xiè dào jiǎo biān , xiàngqián yíbù .
pairs.english: Du Heng lowered the hauling line to his feet and stepped forward once.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡把吊索卸到脚边，向前一步。

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng zhe nà zhījiàn , tā hái hǎohǎo dì qiàn zài mù liáng shàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao watched the arrow; it was still firmly embedded in the beam.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望着那支箭，它还好好地嵌在木梁上。

pairs.target: " zài nǎér ? "
pairs.english: “Where?”
pairs.hanzi: “在哪儿？”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu wèn .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou asked.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟问。

pairs.target: " jiàn hòumiàn .
pairs.english: “Behind the arrow.
pairs.hanzi: “箭后面。

pairs.target: tīngbùchū jǐgè . "
pairs.english: I can't tell how many by listening.”
pairs.hanzi: 听不出几个。”

pairs.target: huàyīngāngluò , liángxiàchuí luò de làn bù dòng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Just as her words ended, the rotten cloth hanging under the beam stirred.
pairs.hanzi: 话音刚落，梁下垂落的烂布动了一下。

pairs.target: yì jié huībái de gōu zú cóng lǐmiàn shēnchū , zhuāzhù mùtou , hòutou tuō chū yìzhī biǎncháng de dōngxī , fùmiàn jǐntiēzhe liáng , liùtiáo tuǐ xiānhòu nuódòng .
pairs.english: A length of gray-white hooked limb reached out from within, gripped the wood, and dragged a flat, elongated body after it, belly pressed tightly to the beam, its six legs shifting one after another.
pairs.hanzi: 一截灰白的钩足从里面伸出，抓住木头，后头拖出一只扁长的东西，腹面紧贴着梁，六条腿先后挪动。

pairs.target: lín zhào yìshí jìng kànbùqīng tā de tóu zài nǎér .
pairs.english: For a moment, Lin Zhao could not even see clearly where its head was.
pairs.hanzi: 林照一时竟看不清它的头在哪儿。

pairs.target: " bèi jià fàngxià , kào nèiqiáng . "
pairs.english: “Set down your frames; keep against the inner wall.”
pairs.hanzi: “背架放下，靠内墙。”

pairs.target: shào píng yǐjīng dūn le xiàqù .
pairs.english: Shao Ping had already crouched down.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平已经蹲了下去。

pairs.target: tā gēnzhe qūxī , jiěkāi xiōngqián de dài kòu , jiāntóu měngdì yìqīng , chàdiǎn wǎngqián pū .
pairs.english: She followed, bending her knees and undoing the buckle across her chest; her shoulders suddenly felt light, and she nearly pitched forward.
pairs.hanzi: 她跟着屈膝，解开胸前的带扣，肩头猛地一轻，差点往前扑。

pairs.target: wēn shù shēnshǒu dǎng le tā yíxià , suíjí ràoguò liǎngfù bèi jià , jiāng dēng gōuguà zài qiángfèng lǐ .
pairs.english: Wen Shu reached out to steady her briefly, then went around both frames and hung the lamp hook in a crevice in the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 温述伸手挡了她一下，随即绕过两副背架，将灯钩挂在墙缝里。

pairs.target: dēngyǐng huàng dào liáng xià , nà dōngxī luò le xiàlái .
pairs.english: The lamplight swung beneath the beam, and the thing dropped.
pairs.hanzi: 灯影晃到梁下，那东西落了下来。

pairs.target: qī lán de gōng zhī zhāngkāi yíbàn .
pairs.english: Qi Lan's bow was only half drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚的弓只张开一半。

pairs.target: lín zhào kànjiàn tā sōngshǒu , què méi tīng qīng jiàn luò zài nǎér , liáng xià nà tuán huī yǐng biàn měngdì wǎnghòu yídùn , dīng huí le mùtou shàng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw her release, but could not hear where the arrow landed; the gray shape beneath the beam then suddenly jerked backward and was nailed back into the wood.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看见她松手，却没听清箭落在哪儿，梁下那团灰影便猛地往后一顿，钉回了木头上。

pairs.target: jǐtiáo tuǐ zhuā le yòu sōng , jiànwěi zài fù xià chàn zhe , xiánshēng sìhū hái liúzài ěrbiān .
pairs.english: A few legs clutched, then relaxed; the arrow's tail trembled under its belly, and the bowstring's twang seemed still to linger in her ears.
pairs.hanzi: 几条腿抓了又松，箭尾在腹下颤着，弦声似乎还留在耳边。

pairs.target: lìngyìzhī cóng zhù hòu cuànchū , zhípū dùhéng .
pairs.english: Another darted from behind the column, straight at Du Heng.
pairs.hanzi: 另一只从柱后窜出，直扑杜衡。

pairs.target: tā jiǎogēn yā wěn , dùn yán wǎng xià yì chén .
pairs.english: He planted his heel, and the shield's rim dipped down.
pairs.hanzi: 他脚跟压稳，盾沿往下一沉。

pairs.target: zhuàng xiǎng zài méndòng lǐ zhèn kāi , lín zhào bèikào shíqiáng , yáchǐ dōu gēnzhe yí pèng .
pairs.english: The crash reverberated through the gateway; Lin Zhao's back was against the stone wall, and even her teeth clicked together.
pairs.hanzi: 撞响在门洞里震开，林照背靠石墙，牙齿都跟着一碰。

pairs.target: dùn hòu de dùhéng què méi tuì , lián nà zhī cǎi zài shífèng biān de xuēzǐ dōu méi nuó .
pairs.english: But Du Heng did not give ground behind the shield; even the boot planted beside a crack had not shifted.
pairs.hanzi: 盾后的杜衡却没退，连那只踩在石缝边的靴子都没挪。

pairs.target: gōu zú yuèguò dùn biān , pānzhù shàng yán , guā chū cìěr de yìshēng .
pairs.english: The hooked foot caught over the shield's edge and clung to the rim, scraping out a piercing screech.
pairs.hanzi: 钩足越过盾边，攀住上沿，刮出刺耳的一声。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu cóng tā yòucè dì chū jiàn qù , nà zhī dōngxī hūrán niǔshēn , lìng yìtiáo qián zú héng zhe sǎo lái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou thrust his sword out from Du Heng's right side; the thing suddenly twisted and another foreleg swept in sideways.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟从他右侧递出剑去，那只东西忽然扭身，另一条前足横着扫来。

pairs.target: lín zhàokàn dé qīngqīngchǔchǔ , nà yì gōu zhèng dǎng zài jiàn qián .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw it clearly: that hook was blocking the sword's path.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看得清清楚楚，那一钩正挡在剑前。

pairs.target: kě jiànfēng yǐjīng dào le gōu hòu .
pairs.english: But the blade's edge was already behind the hook.
pairs.hanzi: 可剑锋已经到了钩后。

pairs.target: tā yǎnjīng hái dīng zhe nàtiáo zú , shěn yàn zhōu de shǒuwàn yǐjīng yì zhuǎn , huī ké dǐxià fān chū yíxiàn ànhóng .
pairs.english: Her eyes were still fixed on that leg when Shen Yanzhou's wrist had already turned, showing a thread of dark red beneath the gray shell.
pairs.hanzi: 她眼睛还盯着那条足，沈砚舟的手腕已经一转，灰壳底下翻出一线暗红。

pairs.target: dùhéng tuīkāi dùn , shīshēn zhuàng shàng zhùjiǎo , liùtiáo tuǐ quánsuō zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Du Heng shoved the shield aside; the body struck the column's base, its six legs curled together.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡推开盾，尸身撞上柱脚，六条腿蜷缩在一起。

pairs.target: yǔshēng chóngxīn màn jìnmén lǐ .
pairs.english: The sound of rain seeped back into the gateway.
pairs.hanzi: 雨声重新漫进门里。

pairs.target: lín zhào táishǒu mōlemō zuǐ , cái fāxiànzìjǐ yìzhí yǎo zhe xiàchún .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao raised a hand to touch her mouth, only then realizing she had been biting her lower lip all along.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抬手摸了摸嘴，才发现自己一直咬着下唇。

pairs.target: tā yòu qù kàn shěn yàn zhōu de jiàn , jiàn shēn méi biàn cháng , yě méi wān , yǔshuǐ shùnzhe xuècáo wǎngxiàdī .
pairs.english: She looked at Shen Yanzhou's sword again; it had neither lengthened nor bent, and rainwater dripped down along the fuller.
pairs.hanzi: 她又去看沈砚舟的剑，剑身没变长，也没弯，雨水顺着血槽往下滴。

pairs.target: fāngcái nà yì jié , dàodǐ shì zěnme guòqù de ?
pairs.english: How exactly had it crossed that stretch just now?
pairs.hanzi: 方才那一截，到底是怎么过去的？

pairs.target: " zuǒbiān xiān bié zǒu . "
pairs.english: “Don't go left yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “左边先别走。”

pairs.target: xǔ cén zhēngkāiyǎn , " wǒ tīng zhe , liáng shàng méi zài dòng . "
pairs.english: Xu Cen opened her eyes. “I'm listening; there's no more movement on the beam.”
pairs.hanzi: 许岑睁开眼，“我听着，梁上没再动。”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu diǎntóu , yánzhe mén cè rào dào zhùláng kǒu , hé dùhéng yìqiányīhòu chá guò héngliáng dǐxià , cái zhāoshǒu ràng tāmen guòqù .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou nodded and went around by the side of the gateway to the colonnade entrance; he and Du Heng checked beneath the crossbeam, one behind the other, before beckoning the rest across.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟点头，沿着门侧绕到柱廊口，和杜衡一前一后查过横梁底下，才招手让他们过去。

pairs.target: qī lán báhuí liǎngzhī jiàn , cā qù jiàngān shàng de shuǐ , jiāng dài bái wén de nà zhī dì hái xǔ cén .
pairs.english: Qi Lan retrieved both arrows, wiped water from the shafts, and returned the one with the white mark to Xu Cen.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚拔回两支箭，擦去箭杆上的水，将带白纹的那支递还许岑。

pairs.target: nà diǎn bái yǐjīng dàn le .
pairs.english: That white trace had already faded.
pairs.hanzi: 那点白已经淡了。

pairs.target: " hǎokàn me ? "
pairs.english: “Quite a sight, eh?”
pairs.hanzi: “好看么？”

pairs.target: shào píng zài pángbiān wèn .
pairs.english: Shao Ping asked from beside her.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平在旁边问。

pairs.target: lín zhào zhè cái fāxiàn , zìjǐ hái zhàn zài yuándì .
pairs.english: Only then did Lin Zhao realize she was still standing in the same spot.
pairs.hanzi: 林照这才发现，自己还站在原地。

pairs.target: tā dūnxià chóngxīn kòu bēidài .
pairs.english: She crouched down and fastened the straps again.
pairs.hanzi: 她蹲下重新扣背带。

pairs.target: " méi kàn míngbái . "
pairs.english: “I didn't understand it.”
pairs.hanzi: “没看明白。”

pairs.target: " wǒ zǒu le zhèmexiē nián , yě méi kàn míngbái . "
pairs.english: “I have been doing this all these years, and I still don't understand it.”
pairs.hanzi: “我走了这么些年，也没看明白。”

pairs.target: tā shuō dé suíyì , shēnshǒu jiāng tā fān jìn dài kòu lǐ de yìjiǎo yīshang zhuài chūlái .
pairs.english: He spoke casually, reaching out to pull free the corner of her jacket that had caught inside the buckle.
pairs.hanzi: 他说得随意，伸手将她翻进带扣里的一角衣裳拽出来。

pairs.target: lín zhào yuányǐwéi tā shénme dōu zhīdào , tīng le zhèhuà , fǎndǎo sōng le kǒuqì .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao had thought he knew absolutely everything; hearing this, she felt relieved instead.
pairs.hanzi: 林照原以为他什么都知道，听了这话，反倒松了口气。

pairs.target: zhùláng lǐ yǒu yíduàn méi lòuyǔ , zhòngrén xiē xià chóngxīn zhěngzhuāng .
pairs.english: There was a stretch of the colonnade where no rain got in; everyone paused to adjust their gear again.
pairs.hanzi: 柱廊里有一段没漏雨，众人歇下重新整装。

pairs.target: wēn shù bǎ shěn yàn zhōu jiānshàng de dàizǐ sōngkāi , bō píngdǐ xià juǎnqǐ de bù , yòu àn le àn , wèn tā zhèhuí rúhé .
pairs.english: Wen Shu loosened the strap on Shen Yanzhou's shoulder, smoothed the folded cloth underneath, pressed it again, and asked him how it felt now.
pairs.hanzi: 温述把沈砚舟肩上的带子松开，拨平底下卷起的布，又按了按，问他这回如何。

pairs.target: tā tái le tái gēbo , shuōhǎo le , biàn bǎ diàosuǒ chóngxīn guà wěn .
pairs.english: He raised his arm, said it was fine, and secured the hauling line again.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬了抬胳膊，说好了，便把吊索重新挂稳。

pairs.target: xǔ cén zài tú shàng tiān le jǐbǐ .
pairs.english: Xu Cen added a few strokes to the map.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑在图上添了几笔。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiào rén lìkè xià nàtiáo liúshuǐ de jiē , shěn yàn zhōu yě méi cuī .
pairs.english: She did not tell anyone to descend the steps with water streaming over them immediately, and Shen Yanzhou did not hurry her either.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有叫人立刻下那条流水的阶，沈砚舟也没催。

pairs.target: lín zhào bèi cháo yǔ zuòxià , jiěkāi yāodài , xiān mō gān bǐng .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao sat with her back to the rain, untied her waist pouch, and first felt for the flatbread.
pairs.hanzi: 林照背朝雨坐下，解开腰袋，先摸干饼。

pairs.target: zhǐjiān pèngdào gānzào de yóuzhǐ , tā cái fājué wàitou nà shēn shī yīshang yǐjīng liáng tòu le , dùzǐ lǐ què kōng dé fārè .
pairs.english: Her fingertips met dry oiled paper; only then did she notice that her wet outer clothes were chilled through, while her empty stomach burned with hunger.
pairs.hanzi: 指尖碰到干燥的油纸，她才发觉外头那身湿衣裳已经凉透了，肚子里却空得发热。

pairs.target: tā bāi xià yíkuài , yǎo le liǎngkǒu , tái yǎn kànjiàn shào píngzhèng dīng zhe tā de yāodài .
pairs.english: She broke off a piece and took two bites, then looked up to see Shao Ping watching her pouch.
pairs.hanzi: 她掰下一块，咬了两口，抬眼看见邵平正盯着她的腰袋。

pairs.target: " nǐ de ne ? "
pairs.english: “Where's yours?”
pairs.hanzi: “你的呢？”

pairs.target: " dài le .
pairs.english: “I brought some.
pairs.hanzi: “带了。

pairs.target: kàn biérén de zǒng xiāng xiē . "
pairs.english: Someone else's always looks tastier.”
pairs.hanzi: 看别人的总香些。”

pairs.target: lín zhào méi rěnzhù , xiào le chūlái .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao couldn't help laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 林照没忍住，笑了出来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ lìngyíbàn bǐng dìguòqù , tì tā téngchū yìdiǎn néng zuò de dìfāng .
pairs.english: She passed him the other half of the flatbread and made a little room for him to sit.
pairs.hanzi: 她把另一半饼递过去，替他腾出一点能坐的地方。
